outcome: postnatal care utilization within 2 days after delivery
cohort: The study included 2105 women who had recently delivered, identified through a secondary data analysis of the 2019 Ethiopian Demographic and Health Survey (EDHS).
finding: The overall prevalence of postnatal care utilization within 2 days after delivery in Ethiopia was 34%, showing non-random geospatial distribution and significant association with antenatal care visits, facility delivery, maternal education level, and media exposure.
mod_finding: Facility delivery was identified as a significant predictor of postnatal care utilization during the critical period.
